text:
Which statement about ethene is correct?
A
It has the chemical formula C2H6.
B
It burns in excess oxygen producing carbon dioxide and water.
C
It reacts with Br2 to produce an orange solution.
D
It reacts with oxygen to form ethanol.

options.label: A
options.text: It has the chemical formula C2H6.

options.label: B
options.text: It burns in excess oxygen producing carbon dioxide and water.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts with Br2 to produce an orange solution.

options.label: D
options.text: It reacts with oxygen to form ethanol.
